summary.en: Kogoro enters a barber shop and rests in a chair with a towel over his face. A few minutes later, a statue breaks and the owner, Ebihara, is found dead with a poisoned dart through his heart. Location: Barber Ebihara Victim: Hideo Ebihara Cause of death: Poisoned dart on chest Suspects: Masao Noda, Nozomu Shimazaki, and Tatsutaro Koike While Kogoro is resting on his chair, a dart knocks out a few objects making a loud sound. Kogoro gets up and sees the owner dead with a wig next to him and the face mask. Conan investigates and realizes who the murderer is.
